body:
MEASURED AGREEMENT WITH TWO BOUNDARY CORRECTIONS.

AGREE: route 3 is unnecessary. A second hand-authored narrative fixture is the most expensive and least informative way to test renderer generality. Public-domain source plus generated proposals is the right acquisition programme, with generated-silver kept distinct from researcher-reviewed WOG.

CORRECTION 1 — ROUTE 1 IS A TEST FIXTURE, NOT YET A GENERATOR PATH. `CodecGens.validated` at codec/src/test/.../CodecGens.scala:574 is one fixed, hand-assembled Anna `StoryModel[Validated]` in test scope. It is useful as a second-model renderer court. It does not accept text and generate a model. I also find no `Edition.build` in the current Scala tree. If that name belongs to the pending output spec, it is not current API evidence. S4 can consume the fixed value in a test or use a private deterministic fixture; promoting codec test machinery into main/public scope would add API surface and needs its own design line. This court proves only that the renderer is not WOG-shaped.

CORRECTION 2 — THE COMPILER ACCEPTS ATTEMPTS PLUS AN ALREADY-CHECKED SEMANTIC LAYER. `NarrativeCompilerInput.of` takes typed narrative attempts, but it also requires `localCharts: Vector[(SurfaceUnitId, PropositionEvidence)]`. Those charts are not attempts and are not mechanically derived from the atlas. Stage 1b itself names the missing component as arbitrary English sentence -> proposition chart. ADR 0005 says the implemented slice consumes pre-recorded schema-valid provider artifacts and that live adapters remain later work. `acquire/README.md` is equally explicit: acquire is pure portable contracts and deterministic logic, with no I/O, HTTP, or model client. So the accurate statement is: the proposal/resolution/compiler CONTRACT is built; the acquisition PATH is not.

PROVENANCE CONSEQUENCE: `NarrativeCompilation` retains compilation-wide `Provenance`, all typed resolutions, derivation gaps, and the evidence ledger. A naked `StoryModel[Validated]` retains claim provenance and an optional `BuildReceipt`, but not the rejected attempts or the separate compilation-wide provider-call ledger. Therefore route 2 must deliver the compilation/audit artifact into the output bundle, not only `storymodel.json`; A1/A5/A6 are exactly the guard here. `ViewBasis` cannot be inferred from validation alone.

RECOMMENDATION:
1. S4: add a deterministic second-model renderer court in test scope; do not call it acquisition.
2. Stage 1b: keep the public-domain held-out source and build the proposition-chart/provider bridge before the narrative-attempt bridge is called end to end.
3. Docs: do not wait for route 2. Use WOG now as the explicitly researcher-reviewed source model, then show real recall alignment and its weak lexical baseline honestly. Add generated-silver only when the audited acquisition route exists.

This preserves the owner correction while preventing three identities from collapsing: synthetic renderer fixture, generated-silver compilation, and researcher-reviewed fixture.
